package contentaccess

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

type allowLessonRepository struct{}

func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewCourse(context.Context, string) (bool, error)  { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewModule(context.Context, string) (bool, error)  { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewSection(context.Context, string) (bool, error) { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewLesson(context.Context, string) (bool, error)  { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewTask(context.Context, string) (bool, error)    { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewExample(context.Context, string) (bool, error) { return true, nil }
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewLessonViaRelation(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewTaskViaRelation(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}
func (allowLessonRepository) CanViewExampleViaRelation(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}

type accessRepositoryStub struct {
	allowed    bool
	lessonID   string
	taskID     string
	relationID string
}

func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewCourse(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewModule(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewSection(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) (bool, error) {
	r.lessonID = lessonID
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewTask(_ context.Context, taskID string) (bool, error) {
	r.taskID = taskID
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewExample(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewLessonViaRelation(_ context.Context, lessonID, relationID string) (bool, error) {
	r.lessonID, r.relationID = lessonID, relationID
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewTaskViaRelation(_ context.Context, taskID, relationID string) (bool, error) {
	r.taskID, r.relationID = taskID, relationID
	return r.allowed, nil
}
func (r *accessRepositoryStub) CanViewExampleViaRelation(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return r.allowed, nil
}

func TestServiceRequiresVerifiedRelationForHiddenTargets(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &accessRepositoryStub{allowed: true}
	service := Service{Repository: repo}

	if err := service.RequireLesson(context.Background(), " lesson-id ", " relation-id "); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("related lesson access: %v", err)
	}
	if repo.lessonID != "lesson-id" || repo.relationID != "relation-id" {
		t.Fatalf("relation context was not normalized: %#v", repo)
	}

	if err := service.RequireTask(context.Background(), " task-id ", " relation-id "); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("related task access: %v", err)
	}
	if repo.taskID != "task-id" || repo.relationID != "relation-id" {
		t.Fatalf("task relation context was not forwarded: %#v", repo)
	}
}

func TestServiceConcealsDeniedAndUnconfiguredAccess(t *testing.T) {
	denied := Service{Repository: &accessRepositoryStub{allowed: false}}
	if err := denied.RequireCourse(context.Background(), "course-id"); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("denied error = %v", err)
	}

	if err := (Service{}).RequireCourse(context.Background(), "course-id"); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("unconfigured error = %v", err)
	}
}

type fixedReadAccessRepository struct {
	access        domain.LessonReadAccess
	includeHidden bool
}

func (r *fixedReadAccessRepository) ResolveLessonReadAccess(_ context.Context, lessonIDs []string, includeHidden bool) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error) {
	r.includeHidden = includeHidden
	result := make(map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, len(lessonIDs))
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		result[lessonID] = domain.LessonReadAccessResolution{Effective: r.access, SourceType: "course", SourceID: "course-id"}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func TestAuthorizeLessonAudienceMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		role      string
		access    domain.LessonReadAccess
		allowed   bool
		errorCode string
	}{
		{name: "guest content", role: "", access: domain.LessonReadAccessGuest, allowed: true},
		{name: "guest needs login", role: "", access: domain.LessonReadAccessStudent, errorCode: "lesson_authentication_required"},
		{name: "student content", role: "STUDENT", access: domain.LessonReadAccessStudent, allowed: true},
		{name: "student needs pro", role: "STUDENT", access: domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro, errorCode: "lesson_pro_required"},
		{name: "pro content", role: "STUDENT_PRO", access: domain.LessonReadAccessStudentPro, allowed: true},
		{name: "disabled content", role: "STUDENT_PRO", access: domain.LessonReadAccessDisabled, errorCode: "lesson_reading_disabled"},
		{name: "admin bypass", role: "ADMIN", access: domain.LessonReadAccessDisabled, allowed: true},
	}

	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			readRepo := &fixedReadAccessRepository{access: testCase.access}
			service := Service{Repository: allowLessonRepository{}, ReadAccess: readRepo}
			decision, err := service.AuthorizeLesson(WithAudience(context.Background(), testCase.role), "lesson-id", "")
			if testCase.allowed {
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("AuthorizeLesson() error = %v", err)
				}
				if !decision.CanRead {
					t.Fatal("AuthorizeLesson() returned can_read=false")
				}
				return
			}
			var accessErr *domain.LessonReadAccessError
			if !errors.As(err, &accessErr) {
				t.Fatalf("AuthorizeLesson() error = %T %v", err, err)
			}
			if accessErr.Code != testCase.errorCode {
				t.Fatalf("error code = %q, want %q", accessErr.Code, testCase.errorCode)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAuthorizeLessonRelationIncludesHiddenCoursePaths(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	readRepo := &fixedReadAccessRepository{access: domain.LessonReadAccessGuest}
	service := Service{Repository: allowLessonRepository{}, ReadAccess: readRepo}
	if _, err := service.AuthorizeLesson(context.Background(), "lesson-id", "relation-id"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("AuthorizeLesson() error = %v", err)
	}
	if !readRepo.includeHidden {
		t.Fatal("relation access did not enable hidden course paths")
	}
}
